scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run check:daemon
scripts.build:all: bun run --filter @ephor/dashboard build && bun run --parallel --filter @ephor/website --filter @ephor/server build && bun run --filter @ephor/worker build
scripts.deploy: bun run --filter @ephor/worker exec:wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config ../../wrangler.jsonc && bun run --filter @ephor/worker exec:wrangler deploy --config ../../wrangler.jsonc

DB.description: Stores your Ephor account, machines and deployment data. Cloudflare creates this database for you.

EPHOR_ORIGIN.description: The exact HTTPS address where you will open Ephor, without a trailing slash. For example, `https://ephor.your-subdomain.workers.dev`. The first part must match your project name. Find your subdomain in Workers & Pages.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Generate a unique 64-character random password in your password manager. Keep this secret for future deployments.

EPHOR_SETUP_CODE.description: Generate a separate random password of 32–128 characters in your password manager. Save it and enter it on Ephor’s setup screen after deployment. It can be used once.
